# Partner B (Rishikesh riverside hostel) — Property Rules

- **Check-in & Check-out**: Check-in starts at 12:00 PM (noon). Check-out is strictly by 10:00 AM. Early check-in subject to bed availability upon arrival.
- **Dorms & Private Rooms**: 6-bed mixed non-AC dorm is ₹450/night. 6-bed mixed AC dorm is ₹550/night. Standard Double Bed Private Room with mountain view is ₹1800/night.
- **Yoga & Activities**: Daily morning community yoga at 7:00 AM on the terrace (free for in-house guests). River rafting bookings and scooter rentals are handled through certified external partners at reception.
- **Hostel Guidelines**: Alcohol consumption and non-vegetarian food are strictly prohibited on the entire premises in accordance with Rishikesh municipal holy city regulations. Smoking permitted ONLY in the outdoor ground garden. Quiet hours observed from 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM.
- **Internet & Work**: Fiber Wi-Fi available throughout (SSID: PandaRishi_5G, Pass: gangavibes2026). Dedicated co-working tables on 2nd floor with universal power sockets.
- **Escalation**: For payment discrepancies, medical help, or taxi bookings to Dehradun airport, contact our property manager directly.
